_note: Generated outfits (decision 0008): which garments each outfit image yields, their slots, and the body regions each may sit on. Colours come from the generated texture; each garment's colours (the prompt's, as hex) only settle which garment owns a colour lying where two garments meet. A garment's loosest overrides its slot's cap on how far a fitted garment stands off the body (make_generated_outfit.LOOSEST). A garment's straps (metres) adds shoulder straps that wide (so its edges can be smoothed as much as any). A garment's scoop (metres) cuts a scoop neckline that deep. A garment's band adds a belt or waistband (width in metres, colour) along its top edge. A garment's sleeve_ease (metres) is the least its sleeves stand off the arm. A garment's top (metres above the floor) is as high as it reaches. A garment's flare [metres, over metres] adds ease towards its hem (A-line shorts). A garment's gather (metres) draws its ease in over that stretch above the hem (joggers' cuffs). A garment's ease (metres) is the least it stands off the body (baggy joggers). A garment's edge_blur (metres) overrides how much its edges are smoothed (thin straps need little). A garment with hood true also takes its hood from the scan (garment_tools.extract_hood).
